t: M.N. Stankoff, Candidate For Position Of Police Watchman

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
No. D 5540
Date 12/12/33
Date December 12, 1933

Subject (in full) M.N.Stankoff, candidate for position of Police Watchman.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the application by Mihail Nikolaevitch Stankoff for a position as Police Watchman, enquiries show that he is Russian, born on September 21, 1889 in the province of Tomsk, Siberia. He took part in the Civil War in Siberia serving with the White Russian Army as an officer. Following the defeat of the White Army, Stankoff left Russia and remained for a few months in Gensan, Korea. On September 23, 1923 he arrived in Shanghai with the detachment of General Lebedeff.

At Shanghai Stankoff was employed with the Russian Bakery No. 493-A Broadway from February 15, 1924 until April 1925; with Arts & Craft, Ltd., from April 1925 until October 1930, when he resigned of his own accord and was given good service certificate; with the River Police (Chinese Maritimes Customs) as a Temporary River Police Constable from October 1, 1930 until October 15, 1933 when he was dismissed. It is said that he had, in general, a good reputation as a policeman but that he indulged in drinking occasionally. Prior to his dismissal he was reprimanded for drunkenness and was taken on 6 months probation. Before the expiration of this period he again took to drinking and was therefore dismissed.

Superintendent Woodfield of the River Police, upon being approached confidentially regarding Stankoff, said he would communicate officially with the Officer i/c Special Branch on the subject. He mentioned, however, that Stankoff drinks only when off duty, and that at times he discontinued drinking for a prolonged period. In the opinion of Mr. Woodfield the applicant may be given one more chance, as he was smart, clean, and strictly attended to his duties.

[Signature]
DEC. 12 1933
Officer i/c Special Branch.
g. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

日期 1933年12月12日

事由（全称） M.N.斯坦科夫（Stankoff），警员职位候选人。

由 D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）呈报 转交人 [签名]

关于米哈伊尔·尼古拉耶维奇·斯坦科夫（Mihail Nikolaevitch Stankoff）申请警员职位一事，经查，其为俄国人，1889年9月21日出生于西伯利亚托木斯克省。他曾参加西伯利亚内战，在俄国白军军队中担任军官。白军战败后，斯坦科夫离开俄国，在朝鲜元山停留数月。1923年9月23日，他随列别杰夫（Lebedeff）将军的分队抵达上海。

在上海，斯坦科夫自1924年2月15日至1925年4月受雇于百老汇路493-A号俄罗斯面包房；1925年4月至1930年10月受雇于艺术与工艺有限公司（Arts & Craft, Ltd.），期间他自愿辞职并获发良好的服务证明书；1930年10月1日至1933年10月15日，他在中国海关水上警察队担任临时水上巡捕，后被解职。据称，他作为警察总体声誉良好，但偶尔酗酒。在被解职前，他曾因醉酒受到申斥，并被给予六个月留用察看。在该期限届满前，他再次酗酒，因此被解职。

经私下询问水上警察队总监伍德菲尔德（Woodfield）关于斯坦科夫的情况，他表示将就此事正式致函特科主管。但他提到，斯坦科夫仅在休班时饮酒，且有时能长期戒酒。伍德菲尔德先生认为，鉴于申请人机智、整洁且恪尽职守，可再给他一次机会。

[签名]
1933年12月12日
特科主管
g. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）
D. S.
